name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Pendulum Clock
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a warm, rustic, and elegant decorative look.
    - Features a 1-layer wooden clock face with a matching pendulum design for a classic and eye-catching display.
    - Wooden thickness: 4mm, providing a sturdy yet lightweight structure for wall hanging.
    - Includes a pendulum clock mechanism for added movement and traditional charm.
    - Comes with matching clock hands, screws, and anchors for convenient installation.
    - Smooth wood surface and vivid printed artwork create a refined and long-lasting finish.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Clock face size: 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm.
    - Pendulum size: 12 x 6 in ~ 30.48 x 15.24 cm.
    - Clock hands:
               +) Hour hand: 7.3 cm ~ 2.87 in.
               +) Minute hand: 9.6 cm ~ 3.78 in.
               +) Second hand: 13.6 cm ~ 5.35 in.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Printed front side showcases custom artwork, names, logos, commemorative themes, or decorative patterns with excellent clarity.

 

  • Installation Instructions:
    - Step 1: Join the side support pieces into the slots on the back of the clock mechanism.
    - Step 2: Securely attach the top wooden plate to complete the support frame.
    - Step 3: Hang the pendulum onto the clock mechanism using the included hook.
    - Step 4: Insert the clock hands in the correct order and adjust them carefully to avoid overlap.
    - Step 5: Install 1 AA battery into the clock mechanism.
    - Step 6: Hang the clock on the wall using the included screws and anchors.
    📌 Note: Please make sure all parts are assembled firmly before hanging. The battery is not included.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a wall clock and a decorative home accent.
    - Designed for wall hanging in living rooms, bedrooms, offices, hallways, or personal spaces.
    - Pendulum movement adds a classic and elegant visual effect.
    - Comes with screws and anchors for easier installation and stable wall mounting.
    - Perfect for everyday time display while enhancing the room with a personalized decorative touch.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for housewarmings, birthdays, anniversaries, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for home décor lovers, collectors, and anyone who appreciates custom wall art.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for Christmas, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, and holiday gifting.
    - Great for commemorative displays, milestone moments, and personalized room decoration.
    - Adds a warm, classic, and memorable touch to any space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Pendulum Clock

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
